scoring_justification: Paper reports layer-resolved LDOS features and optimized geometry, which are checked via structural conditions (metallic S-layer, insulating C-layer, empty acceptor states, bridge site, tilt angle). Recomputing from raw wavefunctions is infeasible in the verifier.

schema.description: Final adsorption site, S–C tilt angle relative to surface normal, and total energy

outputs.description: Geometric properties of the relaxed adsorption structure.
Layer-resolved density of states around the Fermi level.

hidden_assets.purpose: Thresholds for LDOS and geometry checks.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the paper's qualitative description: bridge site, S–C tilt ~50°, metallic S layer, insulating C layer, empty acceptor states above Ef.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Set tolerances consistent with the expected DFT output (e.g., tilt within 45-55°, LDOS_S at Ef > 0.02 states/eV, LDOS_C at Ef < 0.02, max LDOS_S in (0,0.5] eV > 0.02).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These thresholds correspond to the physical characteristics described in the paper and are not arbitrary; they are necessary to distinguish an authentic layer-resolved DOS from a trivial artifact.
